source: Create a professional colorful Obby (parkour) game with multiple unique stages, moving platforms, disappearing blocks, and a working checkpoint system that saves player progress

image_prompt.text: A chain of platforms spaced to the physics limits, running the ordered route through every stage of the course
Long horizontal jumps, trampoline boosts, wrap-arounds and stepped vertical platforms across the stages
Moving platforms that slide or float along set paths, plus rotating and swinging elements
Blocks that disappear shortly after being stepped on, and platforms that vanish a set time after activation
Flat enclosed pads at the end of each stage where players land safely
multiple unique stages, each a visually distinct platforming challenge rather than a repeat of the same blocks

layout_placement.text: Respawn points at each stage boundary so failure returns the player to the current stage rather than the start
progress saved across sessions so a returning player resumes at their furthest checkpoint

notes: Shape defaulted to a flat course. The prompt says multiple stages but never says the course climbs or towers, and terraced or tower shapes would add pipeline cost the prompt did not ask for.
The saving half of the checkpoint system is data persistence, not layout. The pad is built here; the save is not ours.
Multiple unique stages is the main structural ask and nothing in shape or options records how many stages there are or that each should look different.

open_questions.ask: Colorful and professional could mean bright toon shapes or clean modern minimalism - which did you have in mind?
How many stages? That decides whether this is one course or a much longer build.

theme: Stylized / Toon - oversaturated colours and clean playful geometry, read from the words colorful and professional

coverage_missing.ask: How many stages should the course have?
Is colorful toon-styled, or clean and modern?
Does the course run along the ground, climb a slope, or stack into a tower?

answers.ask: Colorful and professional could mean bright toon shapes or clean modern minimalism - which did you have in mind?
answers.answer: Use bright, colorful toon-style obstacle shapes with clean, polished presentation.

answers.ask: How many stages? That decides whether this is one course or a much longer build.
answers.answer: Build a small, plainly playable course of 10 unique stages, with checkpoints saving progress throughout.
